description.p: ngPlayer plays tracker modules: the music of the demoscene, of games and of the trackers of the 1990s and today. It plays 31 formats, among them MOD, XM, IT and S3M, AdLib/OPL music, Atari TFMX and AHX. Each format has its own replayer that follows the original software.

The pattern view scrolls exactly in time with what you hear. The scopes, the orb and the voxel landscape show the music, next to a spectrum analyser and level meters. The header shows a rotating 3D model of the sound card the song was made for.
Files and folders can be opened or dropped on the window. The built-in Mod Archive dialog fetches a module by its ID or draws a random one.
